entries.proposition: 🔴 ATR IS NEVER MEASURED IN THIS PAPER. The title, the abstract and every conclusion speak of ATR checkpoint activation; the antibody list contains CHK1, p-CHK1(S296), p-H2AX, ATM, p-ATM(S1981), KAP1, p-KAP1, p-histone H3, WWOX, GAPDH, HSP90 and lamin A/C — and NO ATR ANTIBODY. Searched over the whole body: zero occurrences of anti-ATR, p-ATR, ATR inhibitor, ATR knockdown, siATR or shATR. The single kinase inhibitor used is KU-55933, which inhibits ATM. Every 'ATR checkpoint activation' in this paper is p-CHK1 phosphorylation standing in for ATR, on the authority of the sentence quoted here. That is a legitimate and common proxy; what is not legitimate is reading the title as if ATR had been assayed.
entries.snippet: the Serine/threonine-protein kinase Ataxia Telangiectasia and Rad3-related protein (ATR) senses the damage and activates its downstream target checkpoint kinase 1 (CHK1)
entries.anchor: Introduction, the sentence establishing the ATR-CHK1 axis; read against the Materials and Methods antibody list
entries.found_or_sought: sought — this is the question the paper was opened with, and the antibody list answers it before any panel does

entries.proposition: 🔴 AND THE ONE PERTURBATION EXPERIMENT DEPLETES THE THINGS IT IS MEANT TO SEPARATE. This is the paper's central mechanistic claim and it rests on a single figure. The text reports it honestly, in the same sentence: ATM inhibition reduced not only p-CHK1 but ALSO ATM, KAP1, ITCH — and, the preceding sentence adds, WWOX itself.
entries.snippet: ATR downstream target p-CHK1 levels as well as ATM and its targets KAP1 and ITCH, were also reduced following ATM inhibition
entries.anchor: Results, 'WWOX modulates ATR checkpoint is ATM-dependent', describing Figure 5B
entries.found_or_sought: found — read in sequence, and the list of what else fell is what sent me to the panel

entries.proposition: THE HALF THE AUTHORS CALL SURPRISING, AND IT IS THE HALF THAT MAKES THE INFERENCE HARD. Under a 48-hour ATM inhibitor, WWOX levels themselves fall. So the experiment removes the kinase, its substrate KAP1, the E3 ligase ITCH and the protein under study, and then observes that the readout falls too.
entries.snippet: Surprisingly, following ATM inhibition WWOX levels were significantly reduced
entries.anchor: Results, the sentence immediately preceding entry 1

entries.proposition: 🔴 WHAT PANEL 5B ACTUALLY SHOWS, AND IT IS MORE THAN THE TEXT SAYS. Under the inhibitor: p-ATM is abolished, p-KAP1 abolished, ITCH nearly abolished, WWOX markedly reduced — while total ATM, total KAP1, total CHK1 and GAPDH are unchanged. p-CHK1 is REDUCED BUT CLEARLY PRESENT, and its induction across the damage conditions is flattened rather than erased. So the panel supports 'ATM inhibition reduces the ATR readout' and simultaneously shows that the module through which the paper routes that effect — ITCH and WWOX — is itself depleted. INFERENZA: with a 48-hour pretreatment, 'ATM-dependent ATR signalling' and 'chronic ATM inhibition depleted ITCH and WWOX' predict the same blot, and this design cannot separate them. The paper reaches for the same caution one paragraph later (entry 4) without naming the duration.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 5, panel B. Eight lanes: MCF7-cont, MCF7-1h/1000rad, MCF7-2h/70UV, MCF7-2h/2nm HU, then the same four under a bracket labelled '48h ATM inhibitor'. Rows top to bottom: ATM, p-ATM, KAP1, p-KAP1, ITCH, CHK1, p-CHK1, WWOX, GAPDH. In the inhibitor half p-ATM and p-KAP1 are blank, the ITCH row is nearly blank, the WWOX row is markedly fainter than its left-hand counterpart, and p-CHK1 shows faint bands in all four lanes. ATM, KAP1, CHK1 and GAPDH are comparable across both halves.
entries.anchor: Figure 5 panel B, extracted at smask=0 from page 7 of the publisher PDF, 1884x1805 px, 269 effective ppi
entries.found_or_sought: sought — the text listed four proteins falling together and I went to see whether the readout fell further than its inputs

entries.proposition: THE AUTHORS' OWN CAUTION, RECORDED BECAUSE IT IS THE RIGHT ONE AND BECAUSE IT DOES NOT REACH THE ABSTRACT. The Discussion concedes that ATM inhibition produces pan changes across DDR signalling. The abstract says instead that 'ATM inhibition was associated with reduced activation of ATR checkpoint proteins suggesting that WWOX manipulation of ATR checkpoint proteins is ATM-dependent' — the same observation without the caveat that the paper itself supplies.
entries.snippet: ATM inhibition results in pan changes that could affect DDR signalling
entries.anchor: Discussion, final paragraph of the ATM-dependence argument
entries.found_or_sought: sought — I read the Discussion for whether the confound is acknowledged, and it is

entries.proposition: 🔴 THE SUMMARY FIGURE MARKS THE ARM THE TITLE ASSERTS WITH A QUESTION MARK. Figure 6 draws SSB to ATR to ATM to ITCH to WWOX with K63-UB, and two feedback arrows: the one from WWOX to KAP1/CHK2 is drawn plain, the one from WWOX to CHK1/gamma-H2AX carries a literal '?'. The paper's own schematic therefore rates the WWOX-to-ATR-effector link as uncertain, while the title states it as a finding. Recorded because the schematic is the most-copied part of any paper and this one is more honest than the sentence above it.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 6, summary schematic. A lightning bolt over a DNA duplex labelled SSB; a black arrow down to 'ATR' in red; from ATR one arrow left to 'CHK1, gamma-H2AX' in red and one arrow down to 'ATM' in blue; from ATM one arrow right to 'KAP1, CHK2, gamma-H2AX' in blue and one arrow down to 'ITCH' in blue; from ITCH an arrow down to 'WWOX' in purple, flanked left and right by the label 'K63-UB'. Two curved blue feedback arrows rise from WWOX: the right-hand one to ATM is unlabelled, the left-hand one toward CHK1/gamma-H2AX carries a '?' beside it. A brace under WWOX leads to 'Genome Stability'.
entries.anchor: Figure 6, extracted at smask=0 from page 9 of the publisher PDF, 1351x1583 px, 193 effective ppi

entries.proposition: 🔴 THE K274 RESULT THAT MATTERS TO DL-THER-095, AND THE CONTROL THAT CARRIES IT IS IN A SUPPLEMENTARY I COULD NOT GET. Restoring wild-type WWOX into WWOX-depleted cells rescues checkpoint activation; restoring the K274R mutant does not. Panel 2C shows exactly that — p-CHK1 returns in the Sh+WWOX group and stays blank in sh-K274R across untreated, IR and UV. But the same panel shows the K274R construct expressed BELOW the wild-type rescue, so on this panel alone the failure is confounded with the level. The paper says it controlled for that with higher-expressing K274R clones in Figure S4 — and S4 is behind the retrieval gate described in supplementary_gap. So the claim of entry 7 rests on a figure that was not seen.
entries.snippet: Restoration of WT form of WWOX, but not WWOXK274R, into MCF7-shWWOX could rescue the defect in ATR checkpoint activation upon DNA damage
entries.anchor: Results, the rescue experiment; the panel is Figure 2C
entries.found_or_sought: sought — K274R is the construct from PMID 24550385 read the day before, so this is where the two papers meet

entries.proposition: 🔴 AND THE CONCLUSION THAT REFINES DL-THER-095 MATERIALLY, IF S4 HOLDS. If lysine 274 carries a signalling function on top of its role in stability, then an ITCH-mediated stabilising lever is not 'add more WWOX protein' but 'restore a specific modification' — and raising abundance by another route would not substitute for it. That distinction is the difference between a plausible therapeutic direction and a misdirected one, and it currently rests on a supplementary panel nobody in this corpus has seen. PREMISE: the claim is DATO in the paper's own words and INFERENZA for us until S4 is inspected.
entries.snippet: lysine 274 is not only important for WWOX stability but also necessary for WWOX signalling upon DNA damage
entries.anchor: Results, immediately after the Figure S4 control
entries.found_or_sought: sought — this is the sentence that decides whether DL-THER-095's lever is about quantity or about a modification

entries.proposition: 🔴 THE WORD CHECK FT-062 ASKED FOR, ANSWERED HERE. This paper's own summary of PMID 24550385 uses K63-linked and stabilization — not 'proteasomal'. So the phrasing 'direct ITCH/proteasomal stabilization' that a commit candidate in this repository attributes to PMID 23370280 does NOT come from this paper and does not come from 24550385, whose language this sentence reproduces. Whatever 23370280 says, it is saying it in different words from the two papers that established the mechanism.
entries.snippet: we recently demonstrated that WWOX is a target of K63-linked ubiquitination resulting in its stabilization and nuclear accumulation
entries.anchor: Results, the ubiquitination section, citing reference 17 which is PMID 24550385
entries.found_or_sought: sought — I carried the question from FT-062 into this reading deliberately

entries.proposition: 🔴 PANEL 4C SHOWS THE K274R MUTANT IS UBIQUITINATED, WHERE THE TEXT SAYS IT IS NOT. The running text reports that IR induced wild-type WWOX ubiquitination 'but not the mutated form WWOXK274R (line 5 vs. 6)'. The blot shows a clear polyubiquitin ladder in every K274R lane, weaker than wild type and less induced, but plainly present — while the WFPA lanes are much fainter. That is consistent with PMID 24550385, which found K274 PREDOMINANT and not exclusive, with K100 still ubiquitinated at reduced efficiency. 'Not' overstates what this panel shows, and the earlier paper's own word was the accurate one. AND THE PANEL IS BETTER CONTROLLED THAN ITS PREDECESSOR: the input anti-GST row is even across all twelve lanes, which is precisely the caveat left open on Figure 5G of PMID 24550385.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 4, panel C. Twelve lanes under a construct table: GST-WWOX in lanes 1-4, GST-K274R in 5-8, GST-WFPA in 9-12, each set untreated, 1000rad/1h, 70UV/2h, 2mM HU/2h, all with HA-Ub. Upper blot anti-HA with arrows at 'Ub-GST-WWOX' and 'GST-WWOX': a dense ladder in lanes 1-4, a weaker but clearly present ladder in lanes 5-8, faint signal in 9-12. Below it an 'Input: anti-GST' row that is even across all twelve lanes. Lower lysate rows: ATM, p-ATM, KAP1, p-KAP1, CHK1, p-CHK1, GST, GAPDH.

entries.proposition: 🔴 A LOAD-BEARING CONTROL THE PANEL CONTRADICTS. The rescue of chromosomal stability in Figure 3D is only interpretable if the reconstituted WWOX is at a physiological level, and the text asserts it is. The blot shows otherwise: the adenoviral WWOX at day 2 is far stronger than the wild-type MEF lane and remains stronger at days 5 and 7. So the rescue was achieved with supraphysiological WWOX and the equivalence claim is not what the panel shows. The rescue itself is real — breaks fall from 5.7 in KO-AdGFP+APH to 1.9 in KO-AdWWOX+APH — but 'comparable levels' is the sentence a reader would rely on to call it physiological.
entries.snippet: Immunoblot analysis revealed comparable levels of WWOX expression in WT MEFs and KO-Ad-WWOX-infected MEFs
entries.anchor: Results, the reconstitution experiment; the panel is Figure 3C
entries.found_or_sought: sought — an expression-level claim in a rescue experiment is exactly where a panel decides, so I looked

entries.proposition: WHAT PANEL 3C AND 3D SHOW, INCLUDING THE NUMBERS THE TEXT DOES GIVE. Recorded together because the cytogenetic result is the paper's cleanest and should not be lost in the qualification above: WWOX loss roughly doubles aphidicolin-induced breaks, and restoring WWOX takes them below the wild-type level, with the empty-vector control unchanged.

entries.proposition: THE INDUCTION IS MODEST AND TRANSIENT, AND THE PANELS PRINT BOTH FACTS WHILE THE ABSTRACT PRINTS NEITHER. Figure 1 carries densitometry under every blot: fold changes peak between 1.5 and 3.4 depending on cell type and agent, and in two panels the last timepoint falls BELOW baseline — 0.6 at 24 h for UVR in MEFs, 0.3 at 6 h for aphidicolin in HEK293T. The abstract says only that 'WWOX levels are induced following SSBs'. A two-to-threefold transient rise that reverses is a different claim from an induction, and the numbers to say so are printed on the figure.

Panel B, HEK293T: APH with 1.0 3.4 3.4 2.7 1.2 0.3; HU with 1.0 1.5 2.1 1.7 1.5 1.7. Panel C, MCF7 UVR 50 Jm-2 with 1.0 2.3 2.1 2.3 2.3 2.7. Loading rows GAPDH or HSP-90 throughout.

entries.proposition: THE KNOCKDOWN AND OVEREXPRESSION ARMS, INSPECTED AND CONSISTENT. Recorded because an audit that reports only what fails is not an audit. Panel 2A shows p-CHK1 and gamma-H2AX rising with UV in control MCF7 and blunted in shWWOX, with the WWOX row confirming the knockdown; panel 2B shows p-CHK1 higher and earlier in HeLa-WWOX than HeLa-EV under hydroxyurea, with WWOX absent from the EV lanes as expected for a WWOX-negative line. Both support the text.

verbatim_locators.provenance_note: 🔴 A PROVENANCE QUESTION RAISED IN FT-061 AND DELIBERATELY LEFT OPEN. The journal is Oncotarget, 2016. FT-061 flagged that the journal is reported to have had a period of removal from MEDLINE indexing and said it must be CHECKED rather than asserted. It was not checked in this run — no route was available that would settle it — so it is recorded here as an open question about weighting, not as a fact. The paper's PubMed record exists and is indexed; that is all this reading establishes.
verbatim_locators.supplementary_gap: 🔴 SUPPLEMENTARY unavailable, AND THE GAP IS LOAD-BEARING RATHER THAN FORMAL. Two supplementary files exist: oncotarget-07-4344-s001.pdf (Supplementary Figures S1-S6 and Table S1) and s002.pptx. Both sit at /articles/instance/4826209/bin/, which returns 200 with a 'Preparing to download' interstitial carrying a proof-of-work challenge (cloudpmc-viewer-pow). That is an anti-automation control the service operator placed deliberately and it was NOT circumvented — the same decision taken on PMID 34268881 the previous evening. What is behind it matters: FIGURE S4 is the control showing that higher-expressing K274R clones still fail to restore checkpoint activation, and it is the sole support for the claim in entry 7 that K274 carries a signalling role beyond stability — the claim that decides whether DL-THER-095's lever is about protein quantity or about a specific modification. Also unseen: S1 and S2 (WWOX induction in further lines), S3 (KHOS overexpression), S5 (G2/M by phospho-H3), S6 (breaks in knockdown, reconstitution and the WFPA and K274R mutants) and Table S1 (which chromosomal breaks fall in common fragile sites). Anyone with browser access should fetch s001.pdf and reopen entry 7 first.
